"Council")` fact; the parse instead uses an anonymous witness `sk_council_1` with no `Name`, and the same file treats the capitalized "Sunken-Cove" as a name, so the two are handled inconsistently.

notes: "the Sunken-Cove station" follows the prescribed name-plus-kind split exactly (`(Member sunken_cove station)` + `Name`), `feather_ration` correctly exposes only its genus, the singular collective subject correctly gets a plain event with no distribution rule, and the absence of a tense atom is the right habitual default.
